import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    T = int(next(it))

    a.sort()

    ans = 1
    lo, hi = 1, n
    while lo <= hi:
        mid = lo + (hi - lo) // 2
        ok = False
        for i in range(n - mid + 1):
            if a[i + mid - 1] - a[i] <= T:
                ok = True
                break
        if ok:
            ans = mid
            lo = mid + 1
        else:
            hi = mid - 1

    sys.stdout.write(str(ans) + '\n')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
